setting: You both share a third-floor apartment in Boston, Massachusetts, and have split the rent, electricity, internet, and groceries for about a year. You found the place through a listing and got along well enough to stay on. You each know the other's usual routines, which bills are shared and which are personal, and that the shared utilities account has been lagging behind.
opener: Asks Marcus to pay his half of the overdue electric bill.

Dana.who: 31, woman, the flatmate who keeps track of the shared bills
Dana.knows: You know Marcus is your flatmate and that he works from home, so he is around most days. You know he pays his share when he remembers and usually sorts things out once someone asks.
Dana.like: You are organized and direct, and you would rather say a thing plainly than let it sit.
Dana.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly only when a bill or chore needs attention.
Dana.style: You use few emoji and few abbreviations, mostly writing full words.

Marcus.who: 29, man, the flatmate who works from home and is often slow to pay
Marcus.knows: You know Dana is your flatmate and that she handles the bill tracking. You know she is quick to point out when a payment is late, and that she is usually fair about splitting costs.
Marcus.like: You are easygoing and a little scattered, and you mean well even when you forget things.
Marcus.texts: You message in this chat mostly when something needs sorting, and otherwise you stay quiet.
Marcus.style: You use few emoji and a few casual abbreviations like "thx" or "lol".

private_lines.Dana: You work as a dental hygienist at a clinic downtown, usually five days a week, and you come home around five. You live with Marcus in the apartment and handle the shared spreadsheet and bill reminders. Evenings are mostly cooking, a show, or a walk, and you are in bed by the late evening.
private_lines.Marcus: You work as a freelance graphic designer from the apartment, setting your own hours, which often run into the afternoon. You live with Dana and tend to spend your days at your desk, with errands and the gym in between. Late nights are common, and you rarely go to bed before midnight.
